intro.title: Last Time...
intro.sub:
Kimi's body made SO many funny noises. 😂
Today, Kimi learns real grown-up skills. Diploma, please!

scenes.title: Ring Ring! Who's Calling?
scenes.caption:
The phone is ringing and Mom is busy.
Kimi's first time answering — all by herself!

lines.speaker: kimi
lines.text: Hello! This is Kimi's residence. Who's calling, please? 📞

lines.speaker: dad
lines.text: Hi Kimi, it's Dad! Wow, you answered so politely!

lines.speaker: kimi
lines.text: Hold on, please. ...Mom! It's for you!

lines.speaker: mom
lines.text: Good job, sweetie. That was perfect phone manners! ⭐

scenes.title: Calling My Friend
scenes.caption:
Kimi wants to invite Minsu to play.
Careful dialing, one number at a time...

lines.speaker: kimi
lines.text: Mom, can I call Minsu? I can call by myself!

lines.speaker: mom
lines.text: You need to dial carefully. Do you remember the number?

lines.speaker: kimi
lines.text: Hello, is Minsu there? This is Kimi, Minsu's friend!

lines.speaker: mom
lines.text: The line is busy? No one's picking up? Let's call later. ☎️

scenes.title: The Veggie Washing Squad
scenes.caption:
Mission: squeaky-clean veggies for dinner!
Leaf by leaf, splash by splash.

lines.speaker: mom
lines.text: Let's wash the cucumbers. You need to clean the vegetables well.

lines.speaker: kimi
lines.text: Clean the lettuce leaves one by one! 🥬

lines.speaker: mom
lines.text: There can be pesticides on them. Wash them several times.

lines.speaker: kimi
lines.text: Scrub gently, or the nutrients will get washed away!

scenes.title: Little Chef, Careful Hands
scenes.caption:
Chop, slice, dice!
But sharp knives are for grown-ups...

lines.speaker: mom
lines.text: Let's cut it into the right size, so it will go into your mouth easily.

lines.speaker: kimi
lines.text: Can I cut it, Mom? Please?

lines.speaker: mom
lines.text: You'd better cut it with scissors. Watch out! You might hurt your hand.

lines.speaker: kimi
lines.text: Be careful with the knife, Mom! I'll use my scissors. ✂️

scenes.title: Nail Salon Day
scenes.caption:
Click, click, click go the nail clippers.
Kimi holds VERY still...

lines.speaker: mom
lines.text: Oh my! Why are your fingernails this long? You should trim your nails.

lines.speaker: kimi
lines.text: Will you cut them?

lines.speaker: mom
lines.text: Don't move. You can get hurt. ...Now give me the other hand.

lines.speaker: kimi
lines.text: Can I cut them by myself next time? ...Carefully! 💅

ending.title: Level Up, Big Kid Kimi!
ending.sub: To be continued... Next episode: Happy Holidays! 🎉
